sample_note: Fresh extended 300 = the next chronological FT fixtures after the fresh 100 (LIMIT 300 OFFSET 150). Zero overlap with the frozen 20, frozen 50 or fresh 100. IDs frozen before evaluation.
selection_rule: season_id IN (2025/26) AND status='FT' ORDER BY unix ASC, fixture_id ASC LIMIT 300 OFFSET 150
by_league_note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — no per-league conclusion drawn.

V4_minus_V2.interpretation: negative = first model better on log loss

causality.property: rewrite all 2025/26 outcomes at or after the target kickoff; target and all strictly-earlier frozen fixtures must be bit-identical

promotion.rule: Do not promote merely because V4 beats V2. A bootstrap CI crossing zero is NOT statistically distinguishable.
promotion.note: Strictly observational. V4 is NOT promoted.
